prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: clean reusable wide hero scene, landscape exactly 2:1, at least 1536 x 768 pixels; only the physical scene, no webpage.
Input image 1 is the approved delivery page comp and is a binding visual reference for the hero's silhouette, composition, graphite palette, material, camera perspective and amber light. Recreate the hero scene freshly at production resolution, without copying its UI or its white lower section.

Scene and composition: a cinematic dark graphite studio stretching edge to edge. A long low black metal rail/track runs diagonally from the large foreground at lower-left into a glowing rectangular amber gateway at upper-right. On that same track are exactly four physical stacks of cream/off-white paper and dark document files, each held between heavy graphite vertical end plates, progressively receding toward the right-hand gateway. Preserve the layered paper edges, dark file tabs, finely textured steel surfaces, gold reflections along the rail and physical paper thickness. The first large paper stack sits at lower-left, the second dark file stack at center-left, the third cream paper stack at center-right, and the fourth cream stack just before the gateway at right. The gateway is a broad monolithic graphite rectangular tunnel with warm amber light spilling from its narrow front opening, exactly like the approved comp. The entire grounded installation recedes to the right in one continuous line, with the four stacks all visible and the largest front plate in the left foreground. Keep the horizon low and distant, a dark gray sky with a muted warm amber glow behind the gateway on the right. Floor is charcoal stone/metal with subtle wide seams and warm light reflected naturally.

Keep the upper-left approximately x=4%-45%, y=8%-37% dark and open for a DOM headline; preserve this negative space. Keep the lower-left margin usable for a small semantic caption. Match the approved hero's elevated low three-quarter camera, graphite steel, paper realism, quiet cinematic atmosphere and warm right-side glow. This is an explicitly symbolic work-method illustration, not a photograph of an actual factory.

Text (verbatim): "".
Every paper sheet, file tab, vertical plate and gateway face must be completely blank. Remove all Chinese/Latin text, headings, navigation, labels, printed marks, arrows, buttons, captions, numbers, logos, watermarks and interface chrome. Do not put pseudo-writing on the paper. Remove the white lower page section, borders, rounded clipping, card shadows, padding and any webpage layout. No new machinery, people, extra objects or redesign. The physical scene fills the full canvas.
